faqs.question: What is a good Halloween quote for my best friend?
faqs.answer: A short original line that fits your friendship beats a famous one, for example "Two witches, one cauldron, endless commentary." If you want a classic, Emerson's "The only way to have a friend is to be one" (1841) is public domain and quoted exactly from Project Gutenberg.

faqs.question: What's a short best friend Halloween caption?
faqs.answer: Lines of 3 to 6 words work best as story overlays: "Same coven since year one", "Two pumpkins, one patch" or "Fangs for being my friend". This page has 10 of them, all original.

faqs.question: Can I use these quotes without crediting anyone?
faqs.answer: Yes for the 62 originals, which were written for this page. The 6 classics are public domain, but credit Emerson, Cicero or Shakespeare by name, because a quote with a named source reads as more trustworthy.

faqs.question: Is there a famous quote about best friends and Halloween?
faqs.answer: The most shared one online comes from a comic strip that is still in copyright, so it is left out here. Emerson's 1841 essay "Friendship" and Cicero's De Amicitia from 44 BC give you friendship lines you can quote freely.

faqs.question: Which quote suits a best friend who lives far away?
faqs.answer: Pick a long-distance line such as "The miles are scary. Losing you would be scarier." Robin Dunbar's 2025 review notes that emotional closeness declines within a few months when friends do not meet, so a specific line on 31 October is worth sending.

faqs.question: Which line will make my bestie laugh on 31 October?
faqs.answer: Try "Bestie rule one: never trade candy without a witness" or "You carve the pumpkin, I eat the seeds, everybody wins." The funny lines here run 9 to 15 words, so post them under a photo rather than on top of it.

faqs.question: What should I write for a group of best friends on Halloween?
faqs.answer: Use a squad line such as "Five friends, five masks, one very loud porch." Group lines suit a post that tags everyone; a single-person greeting page is the wrong tool for a whole group.

faqs.question: Do close friendships really affect health?
faqs.answer: A 2010 PLOS Medicine meta-analysis of 148 studies and 308,849 people found a 50% higher likelihood of survival for people with stronger social relationships. A 2023 study of 12,998 adults over 50 linked stronger friendships to lower mortality risk but also to more smoking.

faqs.question: Should I send a spooky quote to a friend after we argued?
faqs.answer: Not first. An apology in your own words should come before any quote, because a pun reads as dodging the argument; skip spooky lines too for a friend who dislikes Halloween or is grieving.

# Halloween Quotes for Best Friend: 62 Originals and 6 Classics

The best Halloween quotes for best friend captions and cards are short, original lines that mix spooky imagery with real friendship: partners in crime, a two-witch coven, the one person who gets your candy. Below are 62 original quotes sorted by tone, 6 public-domain friendship lines checked word for word against Project Gutenberg, and a table matching each tone to a caption, card or story. Keep them tight: on SubhSandesh, 48.3% of shared pages are opened on a phone and each averages 11.1 views, so lines get read on small screens, often twice.

## What makes a Halloween quote about best friends work?

A best friend Halloween quote is a shareable saying about close friendship told through October imagery: masks, candy, covens, haunted houses. Unlike a message, it addresses nobody, so it works as a caption, card front or story overlay.

The good ones are specific. Dunbar's [2025 review of friendship and health](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC11918532) describes layers of roughly 1.5 intimate friends, 5 close friends and 15 best friends, so a line that fits only your person beats a generic pun.

## 6 public-domain friendship quotes, checked against Project Gutenberg

These six come from out-of-copyright texts. Each matches the Gutenberg edition named, punctuation included.

1. > "A friend is a person with whom I may be sincere. Before him I may think aloud."

   Ralph Waldo Emerson, "Friendship", *Essays: First Series* (1841), [Project Gutenberg #2944](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/2944).

2. > "The only way to have a friend is to be one."

   Emerson, same essay (1841), mid-sentence in the original.

3. > "A friend may well be reckoned the masterpiece of nature."

   Emerson, same essay (1841), closing a longer sentence.

4. > "Such friendship enhances prosperity, and relieves adversity of its burden by halving and sharing it."

   Cicero, *De Amicitia* (44 BC), section 6, E. S. Shuckburgh's translation, [Project Gutenberg #2808](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/2808).

5. > "In the face of a true friend a man sees as it were a second self."

   Cicero, *De Amicitia* (44 BC), section 7, same translation.

6. > "Those friends thou hast, and their adoption tried, / Grapple them unto thy soul with hoops of steel;"

   Polonius, *Hamlet*, Act 1, Scene 3 (written 1599 to 1601), [Project Gutenberg #1524](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1524).

The most shared "best friend" Halloween line online is from a comic strip. That strip is still in copyright, so the line is left out.

## 62 original Halloween quotes for your best friend, sorted by tone

Every line below was written for this page, so you can post it without crediting anyone. Lengths run from 3 to 15 words.

### Partners-in-crime quotes (9)

- Partners in crime, and the crime is eating the good candy first.
- Every haunted house is less haunted with you holding the torch.
- We don't scream at horror films; we scream at each other's commentary.
- Two masks, one plan, zero chance of anyone telling us apart.
- You bring the getaway bike, I'll bring the pillowcase of loot.
- Somewhere a ghost is telling stories about the two of us.
- Best friends: the only alibi that holds up every 31 October.
- If we split up in the haunted maze, we meet at the snack stand.
- Trouble walks in pairs, and tonight it's wearing matching capes.

### Witchy sisterhood and coven quotes (9)

- She's not just my best friend; she's my familiar with better taste in boots.
- Two witches, one cauldron, endless commentary.
- Sisters by spell, not by blood.
- Our friendship is the only potion that never needed a recipe.
- One candle lit for each year you've survived my chaos.
- When the moon is full, so is our group chat.
- A good witch knows her power. A wise one keeps her best friend close.
- We were brewing trouble long before we owned the hats.
- She reads tarot, I read the room, and together we're unstoppable.

### Funny best friend Halloween quotes (9)

- You're the one person who gets half my candy, minus the peanut butter cups.
- My best friend and I share one costume budget and two very different ideas.
- She said "nothing scary this year" and then booked the haunted hayride.
- I'd follow you into a haunted house. I'd also run out ahead of you.
- Best friends check the back seat for you and then hide in it.
- We're not scared of ghosts. We're scared of last year's group photo.
- You carve the pumpkin, I eat the seeds, everybody wins.
- Bestie rule one: never trade candy without a witness.
- Our costume was a team effort, and the team was mostly a hot glue gun.

### Sentimental best friend quotes (8)

- Every October I count my blessings, and you're always the first one.
- Through every dark night, you were the porch light I walked toward.
- At midnight the masks come off, but you've known my real face for years.
- Some friends haunt your memories; you live in all the best ones.
- Years of Octobers, and you're in every one worth remembering.
- Next to you, even a power cut feels like the cosy part of October.
- Ghost stories end, but the ones we share keep getting longer.
- I don't need a spell for luck. I found you.

### Short best friend Halloween quotes, under 8 words (10)

- My boo-st friend, always.
- Bestie by day, banshee by night.
- Same coven since year one.
- Fangs for being my friend.
- Two pumpkins, one patch.
- Spooky season, same sidekick.
- Partners in candy crime.
- My favourite ghost to haunt.
- Friends who fright together.
- Never trick-or-treat alone.

### Squad and group Halloween quotes (9)

- Every squad needs a planner, a screamer and someone holding the snacks.
- Our group costume took three weeks of arguing and one afternoon of sewing.
- A full moon, a full table and every chair taken by someone I love.
- The haunted house staff still talk about our group.
- One of us is the brave one. We still don't know who.
- We travel as a pack, like werewolves with better hair.
- The group chat name changes every October; the friends never do.
- Five friends, five masks, one very loud porch.
- If you hear screaming, it's just us counting the costume vote.

### Long-distance bestie Halloween quotes (8)

- Different time zones, same terrible taste in horror films.
- The miles are scary. Losing you would be scarier.
- I'll carve your initial into my pumpkin so you're on my porch tonight.
- One moon over both our porches, so we're basically together.
- You're a video call away, which is closer than any ghost gets.
- Distance is a haunting I'll put up with for a friend like you.
- Two cities, two costumes, one photo split down the middle.
- Saving you the best candy until I see you again, even if it's stale.

## Which best friend quote fits where?

Seven tones are grouped into five rows by where they work best. Lengths are counted from this page's lines.

| Tone | Best use | Length (words) | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| Partners in crime and funny | Photo caption | 9 to 15 | "Bestie rule one: never trade candy without a witness." |
| Witchy and squad | Group post caption | 6 to 14 | "Two witches, one cauldron, endless commentary." |
| Sentimental | Card or letter | 10 to 14 | "I don't need a spell for luck. I found you." |
| Short | Story overlay | 3 to 6 | "Same coven since year one." |
| Long-distance | Card or story | 9 to 14 | "The miles are scary. Losing you would be scarier." |

Funny lines run longest, so they belong under a photo. Story overlays want the 3 to 6 word lines.

## Why a friendship quote is worth more than a caption

A [2010 meta-analysis in PLOS Medicine](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC2910600) pooled 148 studies with 308,849 participants and found a 50% higher likelihood of survival for people with stronger social relationships.. Participants were followed for 7.5 years on average.

A [2023 study in Epidemiology and Psychiatric Sciences](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC10689060) tracked 12,998 US adults over 50 across 35 outcomes. Stronger friendships went with lower mortality risk and better mood, but also more smoking: a dual effect, the authors say.

For long-distance besties, Dunbar's review is blunt: when friends fail to meet often enough, emotional closeness declines measurably within a few months. A quote won't replace a visit, but a specific one on 31 October shows you are still tending it.

## Putting one quote on a Halloween page for your best friend

For one person, the [interactive Halloween card](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) has a bestie mode whose closing question becomes "Will you be my boo-st friend forever?". Your friend knocks three times on a haunted house, carves a jack-o'-lantern until your word glows, and finds up to six of your photos behind foggy portraits.

Put a sentimental quote in the letter they read by flashlight and list 3 to 5 shared memories as potion ingredients. The closing Boo License is a 1080×1920 PNG, Instagram Story size, so a short quote suits it, and you get an email the first time they answer.

The [premium Halloween page](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) adds a voice note of up to 60 seconds, up to 12 photos and one 280-character reply emailed back to you. Both are one-person pages, not group cards; [browse all templates](https://subhsandesh.in/templates) for other occasions. Since 38.5% of SubhSandesh creators password-protect their page before sharing it, keep private jokes behind the link.

## When a Halloween quote is the wrong choice

After a fight, apologise in your own words first; a pun reads as dodging it. Skip spooky lines for a friend who dislikes Halloween or is grieving, where "haunting" jokes sting.

The pages have limits too: the interface is English only, and the walk-through suits a phone in hand, not a party screen. If your squad is all in one room on 31 October, a quote carved into the pumpkin beats any link.

## Sources

- Holt-Lunstad et al., "Social Relationships and Mortality Risk", *PLOS Medicine*, July 2010 ([Europe PMC](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC2910600)).
- Kim et al., "United we thrive", *Epidemiology and Psychiatric Sciences*, 2023 ([Europe PMC](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC10689060)).
- Dunbar, "Why friendship and loneliness affect our health", *Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences*, March 2025 ([Europe PMC](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC11918532)).
- Emerson, *Essays: First Series* (1841), Gutenberg eBook #2944, released December 2001.
- Cicero, *Treatises on Friendship and Old Age*, trans. Shuckburgh, Gutenberg eBook #2808, released September 2001.
- Shakespeare, *Hamlet*, Gutenberg eBook #1524, released November 1998.
